notes.title: Finally set to be released in the first half of 2025 on multiple platforms!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/93f21238f97cf269142178b4da52e9a136c2d350.png
Thank you for waiting so long! The complete edition will be released on Nintendo Switch,Xbox Siries X,PS4 and PS5 in the first half of 2025! The publisher is KEMCO, a Japanese company!

 A prequel story about Ars and Memento
  New event illustrations

These will be added to the Steam version for free as an update, available at the same time as the Switch release.
I believe this game has been nurtured by our Steam users, and I would be grateful if you could accept our heartfelt thanks!
However, due to some issues with a Chinese company, the contract was terminated, so the Chinese language will not be available in the  Nintendo Switch,Xbox Siries X,PS4 and PS5 version. Since I want many players from Chinese-speaking regions to enjoy the game, I hope to work something out through further discussions.

notes.title: We're working on the update right now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/113bbbe9caea7db1a62ce68e3d5112abd682747c.png
We had actually planned to update this game in time for the STEAM Winter Sale, but due to unexpected bug problems, the fix is long overdue!
This game will be updated in two parts.

1. 100 consecutive calls, and a new story.
Vanitas will try to master his craft by making 100 consecutive calls! And the more calls he clears, the more new stories will be released.
2. The story of each character's past.
The story of each character's past will revolve around the reaper days of Ars and Memento.

First, 100 consecutive calls are scheduled to be updated. We would like to update it by the end of 2022 as much as possible, but will we be able to do it in time...!

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

Indiegara has asked us to do a bundle sale before the big update
https://www.indiegala.com/bundle/donuts-call-bundle

notes.title: The new update will start in March 2022!
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay in the update
Director's disease treatment has been affected by the medical crunch caused by the coronavirus outbreak
Director's illness is worsening and we have decided to forgo this month's update.
We will focus on treating her illness for the next month

In the meantime, our team members will be working on new projects and preparing updates for this title.
I hope to be back in the studio in good health

Furoshiki Lab. Head Directer 
Dendaira Kotaro
